quest.title: In Another Land
quest.description: The researcher from Sumeru, Alrani, seems to have come up with a new idea for her thesis...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Hey! Traveler, why are you here?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: After you helped me gather some materials previously, I was preparing to write a thesis on Visions and elemental powers.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: The outline was drawn up, the materials were found, and you were a special example of someone who does not have Vision but could still use the power of the elements.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: So I wrote up the first draft and sent it to the Akademiya for my tutor to review, but...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: "The topic is shallow, the logic is unclear, the content is rambling and incomprehensible."

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: My paper was summarily rejected. Again.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So it's a rewrite for you, then?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Yeah. Hahaha... Well, I've rewritten it twice already. What's another time?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: The first time, I wanted to go to Mondstadt to collect data and to write a paper about life in Mondstadt and The Four Winds.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: But as soon as I passed the Stone Gate, I heard that The Dragon of the East, Dvalin, who should be one of The Four Winds of Mondstadt, had suddenly started attacking the city of Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I specifically went to Mondstadt to consult with Mr. Sayid, but he didn't know the reason either, and couldn't help me with my paper.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Since I didn't have a core argument or any evidence, I had to change the topic...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you went to Liyue?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Yes! I thought that since the Geo Archon in Liyue is so diligent, and personally guards Liyue Harbor, and also helps to guide its overall development...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: If I wrote a paper on the relationship between the Geo Archon and Liyue Harbor, there should be enough material.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: And then— and then, Morax suddenly... Ohh...

choices.text: No one wanted that kind of accident to happen.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: After failing twice, I had no other choice. If I couldn't put a good paper together, I wouldn't be able to show my face back at the Akademiya again.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: So I wanted to go out into Liyue's countryside to investigate and find a paper topic. But you already know what happened next...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: To tell you the truth, even when I was captured by the Treasure Hoarders and pressed for the whereabouts of the treasure, I still felt less stressed than when I was writing my paper.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: After all, I had a clear idea of what those guys wanted from me, whereas I have no idea what my tutor wants from my paper even now...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is writing a paper that scary?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: The writing's not the scary part, it's my tutor. My tutor is actually a very patient and knowledgeable person.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: But when it comes to "Essay-Writing Guidance," no matter what the tutor was like before, they all suddenly become super scary.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: So I still haven't been able to hand in my paper, and the deadline is getting closer and closer. My tutor must be losing patience.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: If I dare to go back to the Akademiya empty-handed, I've no doubt that he will banish me to sweep the library forever...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: As such, I came to Inazuma to find less popular topics, such as the Inazuman people's living conditions under the Vision Hunt Decree...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't get caught again...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I won't. I mean, I don't have a Vision. In Inazuma, this might actually be considered an advantage.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I've worked out how to conduct the investigation, starting with <color=#00E1FFFF>recording the daily life of the people on this island</color>.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: If you're interested, Traveler, you could come and help me with the recording.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Let's go. There are still a great many shops on this island for us to explore.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Let's start with this one called Eipekkusu.

choices.text: Do you want me to help you again?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: No. It's just that... I came to Inazuma alone, and I don't know anyone except for you.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: It would be comforting to work with people I know.

choices.text: Well, at least that didn't happen while you were writing your paper.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Hahaha... Yeah, I think I might have lost it if that had happened...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Ugh, don't even mention my paper...

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: So that's what Inazuman specialties are like... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Hey, what are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Hello! I'm Alrani, a scholar from Sumeru. I'm doing research on Inazuma for an academic paper.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Investigating us at a time like this? So suspicious...

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: I don't care what your purpose is. You're disturbing me, so just leave.

talks.objective: Take a photo of Eipekkusu and its owner

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Hey, what are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Hello! I'm from...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: A researcher from the Akademiya, right? I didn't expect to see someone like you here...

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: How did you...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: I just had to take one look at you to know you're a researcher. There's plenty of them back in Sumeru after all.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Did you come all the way here from Sumeru to Inazuma for this... so-called "sociological study"?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Yes. I'm just making some preparations. Are you also from the Akademiya...?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: No, I haven't the talent to be an academic. I'm just an ordinary businessman.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Since you're writing a paper, you can record whatever you like here if you want, but first, let me give you some advice.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: The Outlander Affairs Agency is wary of outlanders like us, so remember to be a bit more restrained while you're doing your research.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: If you get into any trouble, it would be hard for an outlander like you, who's only just come to Inazuma, to extricate themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I... I understand, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Well, off you go then. Start writing stuff down.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Have you found the ingredients?

talks.objective: Take a photo of Syavushi Bakshesh Shoppe and its owner

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: What can you make with <color=#00E1FFFF>a portion of Fish</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>a portion of Seagrass</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>a portion of Rice</color>, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: *sigh* Didn't I just tell you? Don't do anything suspicious.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: You still haven't gotten all your permits squared away. If the Outlander Affairs Agency got involved, there would be no way to resolve things peacefully. Fortunately, I was paying attention to what you were doing.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Well, they are that serious. See the checkpoint in Ritou? If you want to enter Inazuma, you need to get a permit.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Oh no, does this mean that I can't go to the other islands to collect data?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Don't worry. I've asked around at the Outlander Affairs Agency before. As it turns out, it might be easier to get a permit if you apply under me, since I'm a businessman here in Inazuma.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Th—Thank you... but why do you want to help me?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Well, I'm not going to turn down the praise...

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: But really, I, too, wish to ask a favor of you.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Oh? But I'm not a good salesperson...

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: It's not about that. Well, this is somewhat embarrassing, but...

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Although I'm in the fertilizer business, I don't know much about these fertilizers.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: When people ask me about the special characteristics of these fertilizers, I can only refer to the instructions that came with the packaging. I don't know enough to say anything more persuasive.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: If you're willing, I'd like you to help me think about... how to market them.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: At least, help me introduce them in a more persuasive manner, such that I'll be able to attract more customers.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: In return, I promise that I'll get a permit for you from the Outlander Affairs Agency so that you can enter other places in Inazuma.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: What do you think? Do you agree?

choices.text: Huh. So Sumeru does have people who aren't researchers of some kind...

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Of course. Not everyone can, or is willing to go to Akademiya to study and become a researcher.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Marketing... I did learn something similar to that at the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've learned that, too?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I've just read some relevant books on the topic. It's all theory — I've never put them into practice.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: After all, the Akademiya was no place to practice marketing in any way.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: But if I study the applications of these fertilizers, perhaps I can come up with some selling points that can be used in marketing.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: That would be great!

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Ah... Let's not just stand here and talk. You're probably hungry after all of that.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Let me make you something to eat.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Traveler, could you help me get some ingredients? I just need a serving each of Fish, Seagrass, and Rice.

choices.text: What are you going to make?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Hahaha, it's nothing fancy, just an old recipe...

choices.text: Is this what they call "fellowship between countrymen"?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Sympathy... well, a little. It's not often that I can meet someone from Sumeru in Inazuma.

choices.text: Is the situation still so tense?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Now, I'm not too sure from where I sit, but I'm pretty sure not having a license is a no-go.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: See the checkpoint in Ritou? If you want to enter Inazuma, you need to get a permit.

dialogues.speaker: Obata
dialogues.text: Hello! You two, what are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Hello! I'm Alrani, a scholar from Sumeru. I'm doing some academic research here.

dialogues.speaker: Obata
dialogues.text: Research? I'm a fisherman. What's there to research?

dialogues.speaker: Obata
dialogues.text: And do you have permission from the Outlander Affairs Agency to do... suspicious things like that?

dialogues.speaker: Obata
dialogues.text: I heard from Gonshirou that this kind of behavior should be reported to the Agency first, right?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Eh? Why? Is there such a thing? I've never heard that one before!

response.speaker: Obata
response.text: You're getting more and more suspicious by the minute... You'd better come and see Miss Kageyama with me.

response.speaker: Obata
response.text: She is an inspector with the Agency. She'd know how to handle your affairs.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Wait, hold on. I'm really just an academic researcher... I'll go report to the agency later...

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Mr. Obata, what's going on here? I could hear the row from all the way over there.

response.speaker: Obata
response.text: Oh, it's Mr. Vahid. Well, these two have been loitering around, claiming to be doing some kind of academic research.

response.speaker: Obata
response.text: But when I asked, they don't seem to have permission from the Outlander Affairs Agency. I was going to take them to see Miss Kageyama.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Alrani, what are you running around for? Shouldn't you be helping at the store?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: You've been writing that paper for so long already. What's the point of rushing it now? Can't you see you're disturbing Mr. Obata?

response.speaker: Obata
response.text: Why? Mr. Vahid, this is...

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: She's a scholar whom I invited from the Akademiya to work as a consultant for my shop.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Because she is writing a paper about Inazuma, she's looking for inspiration around these parts.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: She just came over from the Akademiya, so she doesn't understand the rules around here.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: I'm still going through the procedures with the Outlander Affairs Agency, but she can't help running around sometimes... I'm sorry for disturbing you, Mr. Obata.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Huh... Oh! I'm so sorry that I disturbed you, Mr. Obata...

response.speaker: Obata
response.text: Oh, it's fine. It was a misunderstanding on my part to begin with. I guess you really are a scholar.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Alright, Alrani, come over here. We need to have a talk.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: Mr. Obata, please excuse me.

choices.text: See, told you not to run around.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Hey... Huh?

choices.text: Why do you need a permit for such mundane things?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: I can't be too sure from where I'm at. But judging by how tense the Kanjou Commissioners are, the situation can't be good.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: See the checkpoint in Ritou? If you want to enter Inazuma, you need to get a permit.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Don't worry, it's more than sufficient. Just a moment. It'll be ready soon.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Wow... It looks delicious. You're a great cook.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Haha, if you live alone for a long time, you will naturally learn this kind of thing. Go on, dig in.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: I'm also doing this for the business. In the beginning, I was thinking about many different ways to market our fertilizer.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: One thing I thought of was to use the vegetables grown with my fertilizer as ingredients to make delicious food, which would help prove their efficacy.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: But later, I realized that the idea of cooking in a fertilizer shop was a little... inappropriate, so I gave up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It is a bit out of place...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Of course, now that I have Miss Alrani's help, I won't have to come up with these terrible ideas by myself.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I'll do my best! But about the issue with the travel permit...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Leave it to me. If there are no problems, it should be done in just a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Still, a researcher coming to Inazuma is a rare sight. What sort of paper are you writing?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Ah, I, um, don't know. I don't know yet...

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I hope to finish the paper while I'm in Inazuma. If I can't get it done, I'll have to go back to the Akademiya to face the music.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: That was a close shave... Well, alright then.
